verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Open WebUI natively supports MCP from v0.6.31 and that users can call tools exposed by their MCP server. External tool servers can be connected in Admin settings, and a community commenter independently lists MCP integration as a feature they depend on. missing for 10: documented detail on supported MCP transports and auth/configuration depth, hands-on independent verification of MCP tool calling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Open WebUI natively supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) starting in v0.6.31.
You can now call tools exposed by your MCP server from Open WebUI.
Give the agent tools beyond the built-ins by connecting external tool servers in Settings → Admin → Tool Servers.
